research.title: Baseline Classification of Customer Support Intents
bullets: Prepared labeled support messages by removing duplicate records, normalizing text, and checking intent labels against the supplied annotation guidelines.
Implemented term frequency–inverse document frequency features with logistic regression, then inspected confusion matrices to document errors between overlapping intent categories.

research.title: Lexical Baselines for Scientific Sentence Classification
bullets: Organized annotated abstract sentences into document-level training and evaluation splits, checking missing labels and preserving sentence order within each abstract.
Implemented a linear support vector classifier using word and character features, comparing predictions across background, method, and conclusion labels.

work.title: Maintenance of Text Import and Validation Utilities
bullets: Updated Python utilities that imported text records, adding checks for missing fields and malformed input under existing application requirements.
Added regression tests for parsing failures and documented validation messages to support routine troubleshooting of the record import workflow.

projects.title: Bag-of-Words Baseline for Review Sentiment Classification
bullets: Implemented a multinomial naive Bayes sentiment classifier with count-based text features, following the provided training and evaluation procedure.
Compared unigram and bigram representations on held-out reviews, inspecting misclassified examples involving negation, mixed sentiment, and infrequent vocabulary.

projects.title: Extractive Summarization with Sentence Similarity Ranking
bullets: Implemented an extractive summarization baseline that ranked sentences by cosine similarity to a document centroid built from weighted term features.
Compared selected sentences with a lead-sentence baseline, reviewing summaries for redundant content, missing context, and coverage of central topics.
